fix_commit_message:
vtls: avoid NULL deref on bad PEM input

Spotted by Coverity

Closes #17274
agent_reasoning: Without the length check, a PEM input whose body (between "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----" and "-----END PUBLIC KEY-----") is empty or consists solely of \n/\r characters would leave the dynbuf unallocated, so Curl_dyn_ptr() returns NULL. That NULL was passed unconditionally into Curl_base64_decode(), causing a NULL pointer dereference inside the decoder. The fix checks Curl_dyn_len(&pbuf) first and only decodes when bytes were actually collected, otherwise returning CURLE_BAD_CONTENT_ENCODING, which avoids the NULL deref entirely.
